tasks.task: formalize page object graph with scope stack (BMO/EMO, resource begin/end scopes)
tasks.notes: Implemented deterministic object model and scope tracking in native renderer.

tasks.task: implement deterministic paint order per AFP semantics
tasks.notes: Single ordered paint stream and base/overlay pass execution in place.

tasks.task: complete graphics object rendering beyond placeholders (rules, boxes, strokes/fills)
tasks.notes: Core line/box primitives implemented; additional AFP graphics semantics still pending.

tasks.task: finalize image object placement with clipping and orientation transforms
tasks.notes: Orientation-aware transforms and clipping implemented; synthetic fallback removed, placeholders gated by image evidence, image-object counting tightened to BIM/EIM, embedded image resolution now requires explicit AFPLib token overlap between BIM and BOC/EOC resources, draw-path prefers resource-resolved images before raw decode, and selection policy now runs through a dedicated ImageResolutionService.

tasks.task: coded font resolution from AFP resources (CFI + resource objects)
tasks.notes: Scoped CFI resolution implemented; sample path gaps remain due missing SCFL/CFI visibility.

tasks.task: code page mapping matrix with SBCS/DBCS mixed-run handling
tasks.notes: Mixed run decode and mapping diagnostics implemented; further parity tuning required.

tasks.task: metric-compatible substitutions and kerning/advance tuning
tasks.notes: Initial metric/spacing tuning added; still significant visual drift vs IBM sample.

tasks.task: remove broad semantic replacement and keep low-signal run-level fallback only
tasks.notes: Fallback narrowed substantially; some safeguards remain while PTX decode gaps persist.

tasks.task: implement IOCA decoding adapters for common AFP image variants
tasks.notes: Common signature-based and raw fallback paths available; coverage not exhaustive.

tasks.task: add validation/fallback pipeline with confidence scoring and diagnostics
tasks.notes: Image decode confidence and fallback diagnostics emitted in meta/diag outputs; raw-candidate classification filters structured UTF-16-like payloads and now reports descriptor payload counts/resource hints.

tasks.task: add per-format decode tests from real sample corpus
tasks.notes: Per-format tests added and image-heavy sample included; corpus expansion remains.

tasks.task: API additions for render/fidelity/resource policies
tasks.notes: RenderPolicy and DiagnosticsPolicy added and wired through conversion options.

tasks.task: CLI flags and help/docs
tasks.notes: Render and diagnostics flags exposed and documented.

tasks.task: richer diag.json and metadata sections for render traceability
tasks.notes: Font/image/resource/print-centric trace diagnostics added; image binding diagnostics now include per-page BIM/candidate/overlap tokens plus candidate payload size and byte-prefix evidence, with explicit image render-path decisions (embedded/resource/raw/unresolved).

tasks.task: build corpus matrix (forms, statements, mixed-language, heavy overlays)
tasks.notes: Current corpus has limited coverage and needs broader document diversity.

tasks.task: per-feature integration tests
tasks.notes: Strong test base exists; additional parity-focused regression slices still required.

tasks.task: CI gates with artifact publishing (fidelity-report.json, diff images, diagnostics)
tasks.notes: qualityGate and publishCiArtifacts are active and passing.

tasks.task: implement dedicated print-centric byte-walk engine separate from native renderer
tasks.notes: AfpPrintCentricTraceEngine established and integrated.

tasks.task: emit sequential token trace (structured fields, PTX control codes, per-byte evidence)
tasks.notes: Trace events, SF/PTX histograms, and byte histogram are emitted.

tasks.task: add AFP-token to output-token cross-examination report
tasks.notes: Added operand-level PDF text operator traces, normalized PTX/alias histograms, and cross-exam inference hints.

tasks.task: use trace findings to back-port proven control-code handling into native renderer
tasks.notes: Extended PTX alias normalization and image evidence diagnostics, filtered non-raster BIM payloads, switched to deterministic matching, surfaced token+payload binding evidence (sample shows JPEG candidate payload with zero BIM token overlap), implemented evidence-driven resource-first image selection, and added a dedicated image-resolution policy service with targeted regression coverage.

tasks.task: stand up SQLite-backed workflow state stores for project and boilerplate automation
tasks.notes: Added dedicated project-state and boilerplate-state SQLite databases with Gradle task integration; workflow JSON/reporting outputs now route through afp-tools database tooling.
